angleRead.name: Simon Leary
angleRead.text: Two games in, and the record says 2-0. That's the whole fact. But the assignment is about a role change inside that record, and the packet doesn't tell me why it happened or what it means. So I'm not chasing a story about the games. I'm chasing the shape of continuity under load. I stand at my desk in Rockridge, coffee gone cold, thinking about how a team that wins two straight can still be in the middle of something unspoken. The role change is the load-bearing beam here—it's the thing that holds up the record, but nobody's saying what it's holding. I want to write about how a record can stay intact while the structure underneath shifts. That's the long view: not the score, but the weight.
